acceptanceCriteria: `GOOS=windows GOTOOLCHAIN=local go vet ./internal/tasks/store/` passes on origin/main, either by moving the shared helper into an untagged test file or by giving pool_sweep_test.go the same unix constraint as pool_process_test.go, whichever preserves test coverage on the platforms the sweep supports.
darwin and linux vet and the store tests still pass.
body: Observed 2026-10-04 by the V1-0645 writer-cost agent at base d4a896bd (before its change): `GOOS=windows GOTOOLCHAIN=local go vet ./internal/tasks/store/` fails because internal/tasks/store/pool_sweep_test.go has no build constraint but references PSRTestResponseFailure, which is declared only in the unix-only internal/tasks/store/pool_process_test.go. Expected: the store package's tests vet (and compile) for windows, matching the package's cross-platform intent. Actual: undefined identifier at vet/compile time on windows. darwin and linux vet pass. Reproduction: the command above from a clean checkout of origin/main. Version: go1.27.1.

completion.reason: Windows go vet of internal/tasks/store fixed in 'Fix the rc.2 candidate's full-gate test defects'; cross-vet passes and internal/tasks/store passes on darwin and linux. Hosted Release gates run 37466658604 on b7b21205 (published as v1.0.0-rc.2) passed full-gate on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04 (make gate incl. cross-vet and go-test), and the local make gate passed on darwin/arm64 with the default symlinked TMPDIR; the SRR-V1 readiness record (sha256 above, corvint-release-evidence/1.0.0-rc.2-b7b21205) was built and verified.

title: tests: Windows go vet of internal/tasks/store fails, pool_sweep_test.go uses a unix-only helper
